name: AI Assistant
description: Answer questions using the current web page, attached files, a user-configurable custom prompt, and locally saved conversation history in the Brave side panel, with local ZIP backup/restore support, automatic page-context refresh on tab changes, sanitized Markdown-to-HTML conversation rendering, bilingual (English/Mandarin) voice input, and a choice of DeepSeek V4, Gemini, or Claude models with independently configured API keys and per-conversation model memory.
